verses.1: Paul, the apostle, was not sent by humans, nor through human means. He was sent by Jesus Christ, and by the Father who raised him from the dead.
verses.2: And all those brothers with me, in the churches of Galatia.
verses.3: May grace and peace be with you from God the Father and from our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.4: That the one who gave himself for our sins may save us from the evil of that wicked one during the time of our father’s punishment, according to God’s will.
verses.5: May its glory endure for ever. Amen.
verses.6: I see that you’ve changed so quickly from being called by Christ’s name to being part of another gospel.
verses.7: There’s no other way; if there are those who are trying to disturb you and want to turn the gospel of Christ upside down.
verses.8: But also, if we or an angel from heaven should bring you good news through us, then it shall be a gift from God.
verses.9: As we have warned before, and I say it again: if anyone among you is evangelized by someone else, then let them be blessed.
verses.10: After all, how can I convince people of anything, or even of God? Or do I really expect people to like me? If I still try to get people to like me, then I won’t be a true slave of Christ.
verses.11: I know, brothers, that the gospel that has been preached by me is not humanly possible.
verses.12: For I did not receive it from any human being, nor was I taught it; rather, it was revealed to me through Jesus Christ.
verses.13: For you have certainly heard of a change in Judaism: that the church of God was overly favored, and it became corrupted.
verses.14: And in Judaism, many traditions were abandoned in my family, those traditions that were more harmful than the ones from my father’s lineage.
verses.15: And when the nurse took me from my mother’s lap, she called me by her name, out of kindness.
verses.16: To reveal his son in me, so that I can evangelize him among the nations. I certainly did not accept any flesh or blood as a condition for this.
verses.17: We also did not go to Jerusalem to meet with the apostles before me. Instead, we went to Arabia. Once again, I was sent back to Damascus.
verses.18: After three years, we went to Jerusalem to investigate about Cefas. I spent fifteen days with him.
verses.19: But I didn’t see any other apostles, except for James, the brother of the Lord.
verses.20: But what I write to you is so true that I am not lying before God.
verses.21: Then we went to the regions of Syria and Cilicia.
verses.22: But I ignored the words spoken during the Jewish assemblies in Christ.
verses.23: All they heard was that the one who is seeking us now spreads the gospel of faith, and this faith will be found someday.
verses.24: And they honored the God in me.
